gen-gf-kodchasan-fs-literata: Literata brings sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, while Kodchasan keeps its terminals open and unpinched. Smooth openness meets measured sturdiness, and that tension is the draw.
gen-gf-kode-mono-fs-literata: Structured and precise, Kode Mono spaces its typewriter-width letters very loosely, with diagonals matching the verticals. Literata, a text serif, softens that with ink-like modulation and sturdy thin lines.
gen-gf-koh-santepheap-fs-bespoke-sans: Koh Santepheap has the mild stroke shading of a letterpress slug. Bespoke Sans keeps generous space where curves meet the stem, so paragraphs would read sharp and unhurried, never heavy.
gen-gf-koho-fs-literata: Friendly and tidy, KoHo finishes its curves well before they close, with barely any stroke variation. But KoHo is best at approachable simplicity, while Literata, a text serif, is best at sophisticated, bookish texture.
gen-gf-kosugi-fs-literata: Kosugi cuts modern, stencil-like letters of one steady width, with daylight showing through every curved opening. Kosugi excels at crisp clarity; Literata, a text serif, at warm, brush-like modulation.
gen-gf-kumbh-sans-fs-literata: Reading as sophisticated and bookish, the text serif body keeps tempered thick-thin variation without razor-fine hairlines. Literata adds modulation to Kumbh Sans, whose outlines never swell, so smooth lines meet a gentler thickening.
gen-gf-kurale-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp, refined, and generous where curves meet stems. Under Kurale, a serif with mild contrast and softly tapering bends, paragraphs would read crisply and without strain.
gen-gf-lato-fs-literata: Generous mouths on its round letters give Lato a clean, modern face, with low stroke contrast. Literata, a serif with a modest gap between stems and hairlines, would carry paragraphs with sturdy, bookish warmth.
gen-gf-lekton-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems. Lekton, a monospace with typewriter widths, rounded-nib ends, and crossbars matching its stems, supplies the structured, precise counterpoint.
gen-gf-lekton-fs-literata: Drawn-wire smooth, Lekton sets typewriter-width letters in rounded-nib strokes. Literata, a text serif, brings joins that slim noticeably yet stay sturdy, so a structured heading sits over a bookish body.
